UGA.note: No authentication service stated; only taxpayer biometric verification for profile updates.
No national ID enrolment count or share stated.
Operation and ownership of the ID system not mentioned.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Finance says a 2025 amendment to Section 4 of the Tax Procedures Code Act provides for the NIN as the tax identification number for individuals, and a three-phase transition to NIN-based taxpayer login is under way.
The Ministry of Finance says that as of 30 September 2026, 2,130,814 NINs had been mapped to TINs out of 5,405,148 individual taxpayer records, about 39.4%.

UGA.note: Nothing on the national ID system's own issuance, biometrics or certification.
No electronic payment of taxes or fees stated; the portal is for updating taxpayer details.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Finance says the URA taxpayer register held about 5.7 million records at 30 June 2026, including about 5.4 million individuals.
The Ministry of Finance says a 2025 amendment to the Tax Procedures Code Act provides for the NIN as the TIN for individuals, with 2,130,814 NINs mapped to TINs by 30 September 2026.
